title: ClearWorld
description: Simple garbage cleanup plugin to improve performance
body:
Simple garbage cleanup plugin

This plugin is designed to automatically remove unnecessary entities on a Minecraft server, helping reduce server lag, improve performance (TPS), and maintain overall stability. It’s perfect for servers with many players or heavily active mob and item farms.

Key Features

Automatic Cleanup – regularly removes dropped items, experience orbs, and other unnecessary entities at configurable intervals.

Player Warnings – sends chat notifications 60/30/10 seconds before cleanup begins.

Flexible Configuration – choose which entity types to remove (items, mobs, arrows, minecarts, etc.).

Safe Zones – exclude specific worlds or entities from cleanup.

Manual Cleanup – administrators can trigger instant entity removal via commands.

Statistics – displays the number of removed entities after each cleanup.
